scope: Public GatedDeltaNet optional output_scale, actual CPU/CUDA direct Compute Prepared/Invocation/Completion execution.

contract.state: Output multiply follows dot reduction; Q/K, recurrent state and snapshot math unchanged

limits: Direct Compute cases do not certify the new Graph/default-provider assembly closure.
